summary: Performance lens. The hook adds one subprocess per Write/Edit/AskUserQuestion PostToolUse event: stdin parse, one file read, one digest, one small JSON write — microseconds against interactive tool latency; it exits 0 early for every other tool. Marker/round lookups are directory globs over per-story records (tens of files) at recorder invocation only, never in hot paths. The grill recorder's ledger match is O(rounds x records) with tiny n. Required-test runs and gate suite times are unchanged apart from the ~30 new tests (+~40s suite).
residual_risks: A very long story could accumulate thousands of round records; glob scan stays linear — revisit only if recorder latency becomes visible
